item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins lawsuit against Trump Administration’s illegal attempt to cut legal residents off SNAP, penalize states for not doing so
item.description:
Publication Date: September 18, 2026

Coalition of 23 AGs wins motion for summary judgment in November 2025 lawsuit: court rules lawful permanent residents remain eligible for food assistance and states cannot be fined for not meeting a retroactive deadline for cutting them off SNAP
